content: Ibagwengine, Asiria-e-rey-Sargón, e-sordamar-bila-onoged-e-dummad, e-sorda-bila-onomaladmala, Asdod-neggweburse barmisgusad. Geb agine, Asdod-dulemargi bila-onosgusad, geb egi nakwisadba Asdod-neggwebur-sunonigusad.

A-ibagangine, Bab-Jehová Amoz-machi-Isaíasʼga sunmaksad. Weyob ega sogsad: “Wile-itoged-mor-yoid be esue, nag-uka-yoid be ungebali.” Isaías deyob imaksad, uka-swili gudigusad, degi, nag-swili gudigusbalid.

Degine, Bab-Jehová weyob sogded: “Igi an-mai-Isaías birgapaa uka-swili e-abganbi-odukudii gusa, degi, nag-swili gudii gusa, Egipto-yalagi ibmar-guoed-e-wilub oyoged, Etiopía-yalagi neg-guoed-e-wilub oyobalid.

Deyobi, Asiria-e-rey, Egipto-dulemar-uka-swili, unnila e-abganbi-odukuale, nag-swili, degi, ber bela sor-daledi, gales sedmaloed. Amba deyobi, Etiopía-dulemar-e-sapingana, degi, e-dulemar-sergan gales seledmarmogoed. A-ulale, bingedar itomaloed.
Dulemar Etiopía-dulemargi bensurmaladi, degi, Egipto-dulemarba-san-dummarbaa-imakdimaladi, nue bingedar itodmaloed, nue bela-bela dobe itodmaloed.

A-ibagangine, dulemar demar-gakagi-bukmalad sogdemaloed: ‘Be dake, we-dulemar anmar-bendakega gudimalansursi. Ar wemarse anmar, Asiria-e-reygi-anmar-ollor-imakega bendakleged amidimalansursi. Emidi, be dake: ¿Igi anmar bar bendaklegosunna? Anmar bar wakinned, sate.’ ”
